# stackit_containerregistry_artifactory (Resource)

Container registry artifactory resource schema.

## Example Usage

```terraform
locals {
  project_id = "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
  region     = "eu01"
  name       = "my-registry"
}

# Standard container registry artifactory
resource "stackit_containerregistry_artifactory" "this" {
  project_id = local.project_id
  name       = local.name
}

# Container registry artifactory configured as a Docker Hub proxy-cache with write-only credentials
resource "stackit_containerregistry_artifactory" "docker_hub_proxy" {
  project_id = local.project_id
  name       = "my-docker-hub-mirror"

  proxy = {
    registry_type = "docker-hub"
    url           = "https://registry-1.docker.io"
    description   = "Docker Hub pull-through cache"

    credentials = {
      access_key               = "my-dockerhub-username"
      access_secret_wo         = "my-dockerhub-access-token"
      access_secret_wo_version = 1
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A user-chosen name to distinguish multiple STACKIT artifactories.
- `project_id` (String) STACKIT project ID to which the container registry artifactory is associated.

### Optional

- `proxy` (Attributes) Proxy configuration if this artifactory is created as a proxy-cache for an upstream registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy))
- `region` (String) STACKIT region where the container registry artifactory is located. If not defined, the provider default_region is used.

### Read-Only

- `artifactory_id` (String) The unique identifier of the container registry artifactory.
- `create_time` (String) The date and time the creation of the STACKIT artifactory was triggered.
- `id` (String) Terraform's internal resource ID, structured as `project_id`,`region`,`artifactory_id`.
- `state` (String) The current state of the STACKIT artifactory.
- `url` (String) The base URL of the STACKIT artifactory.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy`

Required:

- `registry_type` (String) Which replication adapter to use for this registry.
- `url` (String) Upstream registry URL to proxy.

Optional:

- `credentials` (Attributes) Credentials for the upstream registry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--proxy--credentials))
- `description` (String) Description of the upstream registry.

<a id="nestedatt--proxy--credentials"></a>
### Nested Schema for `proxy.credentials`

Required:

- `access_key` (String) Access key or username for the upstream registry.

Optional:

- `access_secret` (String, Sensitive) Access secret or password for the upstream registry. Write-only argument `access_secret_wo` should be preferred.
- `access_secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only access secret or password for the upstream registry - never stored in state and never returned by the API. To rotate the secret, update this value AND increment `access_secret_wo_version`. Changing this field alone will NOT trigger an update.
- `access_secret_wo_version` (Number) User-managed rotation counter for `access_secret_wo`. Must be incremented every time `access_secret_wo` is updated.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [` + "`" + `import` + "`" + ` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the ` + "`" + `id` + "`" + ` attribute, for example:

```terraform
# Only use the import statement if you want to import an existing Container Registry artifactory
import {
  to = stackit_containerregistry_artifactory.this
  id = "${local.project_id},${local.region},ARTIFACTORY_ID"
}
```
